Memory Leak in WPF TextBlock with Data-Bound Text and StaticResource FontFamily

### Description

1. Summary

When a TextBlock in a WPF application (targeting .NET 7.0 on Windows 10) uses a FontFamily defined as a StaticResource and its Text property is data-bound to a changing string property, the application exhibits a continuous increase in unmanaged memory. Analysis suggests that an UnmanagedMemoryStream (or similar underlying unmanaged memory allocation for font data) is being repeatedly created upon Text property changes but is not being properly released, leading to a memory leak.

2. Environment

Operating System: Windows 10 
.NET SDK/Runtime Version: .NET 7.0
WPF Application Framework: .NET 7.0 WPF
IDE: Visual Studio 2022

### Reproduction Steps

There is a simple demo for reproduce，two patches are set in the code to output to the console when UnmanagedMemoryStream is initialized and disposed.

[FontMemoryLeak.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20363230/FontMemoryLeak.zip)

### Expected behavior

UnmanagedMemoryStream can be disposed normally

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6c880551-33da-43ec-88b2-9cace59432e8)

### Actual behavior

UnmanagedMemoryStream can’t  be disposed

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/63e016bc-a6d8-4269-8f8c-a489585cddcc)
